# vcp_applications (Data Source)

Fetches a list of available applications. Can be optionally filtered by location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List preinstalled applications. Optionally filter by location.
data "vcp_applications" "all" {}

data "vcp_applications" "by_location" {
  location_id = "kz"
}

# Parameters an application asks for, and whether a language model key can be
# issued for it, by application ID.
output "application_parameters" {
  value = {
    for app in data.vcp_applications.by_location.applications : app.id => {
      llm_key_enabled = app.llm_key_enabled
      required        = [for p in app.parameters : p.name if p.required && p.default == null]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location_id` (String) Optional location ID to filter applications

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) List of available applications (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Application ID
- `images` (List of String) List of available images for this application
- `llm_key_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a platform language model key can be issued for the application: `issue_llm_key` in the `applications` block of `vcp_server` is accepted only when this is `true`.
- `location_id` (String) Location ID where application is available
- `parameters` (Attributes List) Parameters the application asks for when a server is ordered; their values go into `parameters` of the `applications` block of `vcp_server`, by `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications--parameters))

<a id="nestedatt--applications--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications.parameters`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String) Value used when the order carries none; empty when there is no default.
- `llm_kind` (String) Role of the parameter in language model access: `Key` receives the issued key, `Endpoint` the inference address, when the server is ordered with `issue_llm_key`. Empty for an ordinary parameter.
- `name` (String) Parameter name, the key in `parameters` of the server order.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the order must carry a value; a `default` stands in for a missing one.
- `secret` (Boolean) Whether the value is a secret that the platform does not log or echo back.
